Prob035_count1to10.code:
module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic reset,
    output logic [3:0] q
);

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset)
            q <= 4'b0001;          // synchronous reset to 1
        else if (q == 4'b1010)    // when count reaches 10
            q <= 4'b0001;         // wrap around to 1
        else
            q <= q + 1'b1;        // otherwise increment
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic j,
    input  logic k,
    output logic Q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
    case ({j, k})
        2'b00: Q <= Q;          // J=0, K=0: no change
        2'b01: Q <= 1'b0;       // J=0, K=1: reset
        2'b10: Q <= 1'b1;       // J=1, K=0: set
        2'b11: Q <= ~Q;         // J=1, K=1: toggle
    endcase
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  logic in,
    input  logic [1:0] state,
    output logic [1:0] next_state,
    output logic out
);

always_comb
    case (state)
        2'b00: begin          // State A
            next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00;  // A -> A (in=0), A -> B (in=1)
            out        = 1'b0;
        end
        2'b01: begin          // State B
            next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10;  // B -> C (in=0), B -> B (in=1)
            out        = 1'b0;
        end
        2'b10: begin          // State C
            next_state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00;  // C -> D (in=1), C -> A (in=0)
            out        = 1'b0;
        end
        2'b11: begin          // State D
            next_state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10;  // D -> B (in=1), D -> C (in=0)
            out        = 1'b1;
        end
    endcase

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input x,
    input [2:0] y,
    output Y0,
    output z
);
    assign Y0 = (y == 3'b000) ? x :
                (y == 3'b001) ? ~x :
                (y == 3'b010) ? x :
                (y == 3'b011) ? ~x :
                (y == 3'b100) ? ~x :
                1'b0;
    assign z = ((y == 3'b011) || (y == 3'b100)) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
endmodule
